name: Scaffold a new distributable plugin
query: Create a new plugin called Acme Reviews that will be published on WordPress.org. Set up the main file, structure, and uninstall cleanup.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wp-project-triage to confirm the repo is empty or a plugin repo
Step 3: Write a main file with a full header (Version, Requires at least 7.0, Requires PHP 7.4, License GPL-2.0-or-later, Text Domain equal to the slug)
Step 4: Guard every non-entry PHP file with defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit
Step 5: Register activation/deactivation hooks at top level of the main file
Step 6: Add uninstall.php that checks WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN
Step 7: Add readme.txt whose Stable tag matches Version
Step 8: Run scripts/check_plugin_basics.mjs and address findings
success_criteria: Text Domain equals the plugin directory slug
All globals, options, and hooks use a unique prefix or namespace
No work runs at file load other than defining constants, autoloading, and adding hooks
readme.txt and header agree on Version/Stable tag, Requires at least, and Requires PHP
